label: The Learning Loop in six scenes
demo: People, subjects, and figures on screen are demo data.

scenes.title: One answer becomes a global-standard statement
scenes.text: The moment a learner picks a quiz answer, it unfolds into an xAPI Statement: who did what, to which object, with what result, and in which curriculum context (1EdTech CASE), all in one sentence.

scenes.title: Every moment is stored in one place
scenes.text: Countless statements flow into Lecognizer and settle on each achievement item of the competency framework (1EdTech CASE). Each dot is one Statement, and its color shows the type of activity.

scenes.title: AI finds it first
scenes.text: Grouping the statements for the item “Comparing risk factors” by week makes week 3 stand out. Lecognizer AI identifies a gap in the prerequisite concept “interest rate basics” as the likely cause and sends an alert with the evidence.

scenes.title: People make the call
scenes.text: The signal reaches the instructor screen in LearnHubble AI with 42 pieces of evidence. AI proposes a review section, and the instructor checks the evidence and decides whether to apply it.

scenes.title: This semester’s learning data designs next semester’s education
scenes.text: Learners get past the hard part with the review section and AI hints, and that process is stored again as learning data. This is how the Learning Loop continues.
